title: 序章第1幕拉开的序幕
content_zh:
dota，defense－of－the－ancients，鼻祖可以追溯到星际争霸的中古时代，而真正意义上的dota最初作为经典游戏魔兽争霸3的一张rpg地图出现，问世之后以其优秀的竞技性和娱乐性迅速风靡全球，甚至于后来几乎90%以上的玩家安装魔兽争霸3是为了玩dota而不是魔兽争霸本身，这不得不说是游戏界的一桩奇事。..
dota游戏的目的是守护自己的远古遗迹同时摧毁对方的远古遗迹，以对立的两个小队展开对战，每队5人，每个玩家控制一个英雄，ai部队会在上中下三路自动刷出并不断冲击敌人基地。
玩家可以通过杀死对方ai部队、野怪、敌方玩家控制的英雄、防御塔等等方式来获得金钱和经验来使自己的英雄升级和用金钱在商店中购买更具威力的装备。
此外，虽然地图中分布着各色的中立怪，但是除了一个特殊的boss——roshan会掉落能够复活玩家的不朽盾和大量回血回魔的奶酪外，其他野怪是不会掉落装备的，这和很多rpg地图截然不同。
随着dota的流行，在后续作品中其脱离了魔兽争霸3的平台开始自立，经过了多年的发展之后时至现在已经更新到了dota－x的版本，虽然各种细节被一再强化，类似语音沟通的众多小细节自然不必累述，甚至依赖早已普及的新型高速网络dota－x可以允许万余人同时作为观众以裁判视角观赏比赛，比观看视频更加身临其境，更有气氛，一下子让大量的dota玩家成为了明星人物，同时带来了巨大的经济效益。
而随着dota－x的风靡，dota－x再也不仅仅是一款游戏，它的一些其它妙用也被逐渐挖掘了出来。
自从国家承认电子竞技类的二级运动员，并且高考可以获得相应加分之后，原本被家长们避之如蛇蝎的电子游戏也一下子成了香饽饽。相较于奥数那种深奥难学又被取消了加分资格的玩意，电子竞技不但孩子爱玩，玩好了还能拿二级运动员证书，高考能加分！
诸多电子竞技项目中，dota系列以其良好的延续性和竞技性一直以来都是电子竞技的主力项目，电子竞技界的常青树。于是乎，一夜之间大量打着“高考前dota培训”“二级运动员包学包过”“职业玩家（三种性别齐全可选）陪练dota”等等诸如此类广告语的培训班如雨后春笋般冒了出来，并且神奇的得到了不少人的追捧。
由此引发的新一轮“打dota会不会加重学生负担，素质教育路在何方”“dota二级运动员滥竽充数，真实实力其实不堪，或存在刷分行为”“高中生考电子竞技二级证是否会影响学习成绩”等等诸如此类的话题讨论至今仍然难以定论。
相较于以dota拿二级运动员证高考加分褒贬不一的争议，dota的另一种应用——以倒品观人品却悄然成为了时下新兴的一种企业面试模式，并且颇受好评。面试只能看一时的能力，倒品却真实记录了一个人在无人监管的情况下的日常品德。
最初的时候，某企业在招聘经理走完了正常的笔试面试程序之后认为有两人难分高下，而公司却只需要一个人，实在是难以取舍。
踌躇之际老总突然发现这两人都有电子竞技类国家二级运动员证书，小项还刚好都是dota，于是突发奇想调出了自己笔记本上的dota－x让两人登陆自己的账号。
由于dota－x实行的是实名身份绑定制，而且对于那些认定可能有不良记录或者发挥异常出色的盘局会强制保存记录于服务器形成信用记录，用户完全无法删除或隐藏并且跟随终生。因此登陆账号调出之前的录像后，公司老总很快便发现其中一人的倒品相当差。
此人不但实力不济还没有自知之明，经常一到逆风局不问青红皂白喷正常发挥的队友而从不认为自己有问题，爆粗口被系统警告的记录足足十几个页面，而且此人不但动口更喜欢动手，送鸡送人头送队友装备乃是稀松平常，甚至经常干出买鸡不开共享偷偷运走中单队友刚刚买出来的魔瓶给自己用上大半场战斗再丢下一句“算了，开恩还给你，dota总归不是一个人的游戏。”扔回去的状况。
至于另一人，dota记录中不但没什么负面记录，甚至就连掉线爆粗口都几乎绝迹，可谓是文明dota的典范，没人监督之下都能做到严于律己，那人品铁定没的说了！
看完了两人的记录之后，老总当即将那位没倒品的应聘者一脚踹出了公司——将这种坑货的玩意留在公司？除非脑子长了瘤！天知道什么时候自己就被对方给卖了！
那位一直趾高气昂，自命不凡，自吹能力学历高上天，各种证件如足够凑出一副扑克牌，年薪要求绝对不能低于50万的坑货在公司老总这一突发奇想上了新闻之后，他的应聘之路也就终结了。
接连被各种公司拒之门外，甚至就连超市应聘勤杂工扫厕所都没人要——没倒品没人品，怕他偷东西。
最终此人只能去工地抗水泥，只因为那里招工不看简历，就这还因为一次酒后牢骚暴露了身份被包工头踢出工地——无他，谁也不愿意背后被队友捅刀子。
自从第一家以面试者在dota－x中的倒品表现来考察其人品的企业大获成功之后，这种面试模式便迅速的推广了开来，狠狠的威慑了一批坑爹者，为净化网络环境做出了巨大的贡献。

高考加分，面试定乾坤，看起来dota－x似乎已经很了不起了，可是事实上dota－x的魅力却远远不局限在人界，甚至不少高高在上的天神也被它的魅力所俘获，开始以dota构建起了一个关乎生死的游戏。
…………
傍晚的齐北市，在夕阳的照耀下某人手中的手机被染成了漂亮的金黄色，大大的屏幕上隐约可以看见一行文字——“欢迎进入天神游戏”。
content_en:
The origin of dota, defense-of-the-ancients, can be traced back to the medieval era of StarCraft. In the true sense, dota first appeared as an RPG map in the classic game Warcraft 3. After its introduction, it quickly became popular all over the world with its excellent competitiveness and entertainment. Even later, almost 90% of the players installed Warcraft 3 to play Dota rather than Warcraft itself. This has to be said to be a strange thing in the gaming world. ..
The purpose of the Dota game is to protect one's own ancient ruins while destroying the opponent's ancient ruins. Two opposing teams start a battle. Each team has 5 people. Each player controls a hero. AI troops will automatically spawn in the upper, middle and lower lanes and continuously attack the enemy's base.
Players can obtain money and experience by killing the opponent's AI troops, wild monsters, heroes controlled by enemy players, defense towers, etc. to upgrade their heroes and use money to purchase more powerful equipment in the store.
In addition, although there are various neutral monsters scattered in the map, except for a special boss - Roshan, which will drop an immortal shield that can revive players and a large amount of cheese that can restore blood and magic, other wild monsters will not drop equipment. This is completely different from many RPG maps.
With the popularity of dota, in subsequent works, it broke away from the platform of Warcraft 3 and began to stand on its own. After many years of development, it has now been updated to the dota-x version. Although various details have been repeatedly strengthened, many small details such as voice communication naturally need not be repeated. Even relying on the new high-speed network dota-x that has been popularized for a long time can allow more than 10,000 people to watch the game from the referee's perspective as spectators at the same time. It is more immersive and more atmospheric than watching videos. It has suddenly turned a large number of dota players into celebrities and brought huge economic benefits.
With the popularity of dota-x, dota-x is no longer just a game, and some of its other wonderful uses have been gradually discovered.
Since the country has recognized second-level e-sports athletes and can get corresponding bonus points in the college entrance examination, video games that were originally shunned by parents have suddenly become popular. Compared with the Mathematical Olympiad, which is esoteric and difficult to learn and has been disqualified for bonus points, e-sports is not only fun for children, but if you play it well, you can get a second-level athlete certificate, and you can get extra points in the college entrance examination!
Among many e-sports projects, the Dota series has always been the main e-sports project due to its good continuity and competitiveness, and is an evergreen tree in the e-sports world. As a result, a large number of training courses with slogans such as "Dota training before the college entrance examination", "Level 2 athletes guaranteed to pass", "Professional players (all three genders available) sparring in Dota" and other similar slogans sprung up overnight, and magically gained the favor of many people.
This has triggered a new round of discussions on topics such as "Will playing Dota increase the burden on students and where is the path to quality education?" "Dota Level 2 athletes are pretending to be good, but their real strength is not enough, or there may be behavior of cheating"; "Whether high school students taking the E-sports Level 2 certificate will affect their academic performance?" and other topics such as this are still difficult to reach a conclusion.
Compared with the controversy over the use of Dota to obtain extra points for the college entrance examination for the second-level athlete certificate, another application of Dota - judging character based on personality has quietly become an emerging corporate interview model, and is well received. Interviews can only test temporary abilities, but interviews truly record a person's daily moral character without supervision.
At the beginning, after a certain company's hiring manager went through the normal written test and interview process, he thought it was difficult to distinguish between two people, but the company only needed one person, so it was really difficult to choose.
When hesitating, the boss suddenly saidNow that both of them have national second-level e-sports athlete certificates, and they both happen to be in Dota, so on a whim, they called up Dota-X on their laptops and asked them to log in to their accounts.
Since dota-x implements a real-name identity binding system, and those games that are deemed to have bad records or perform exceptionally well will be forced to save records on the server to form a credit record, which users cannot delete or hide at all and will follow them for life. Therefore, after logging into the account to call up the previous video, the company boss quickly discovered that one of them had a very poor quality.
This person is not only weak in strength, but also has no self-awareness. He often ignores his teammates who are performing normally in headwind situations and never thinks that there is something wrong with him. There are more than ten pages of records of being warned by the system for swearing. Moreover, this person not only uses words but also likes to use hands, giving away chickens and heads. The equipment of teammates is very common, and they often even share it and secretly take away the magic bottle that the mid laner's teammate just bought and use it for most of the battle before throwing it back with the sentence "Forget it, I'll give it back to you, Dota is not a one-person game after all."
As for the other person, there are not only no negative records in the Dota record, but even the use of swear words during disconnections is almost non-existent. He can be said to be a model of civilized Dota. He can be strict with himself without supervision, and his character is definitely beyond words!
After reading the records of the two people, the boss immediately kicked the unsuccessful applicant out of the company - leaving such a scam in the company? Unless there is a tumor on the brain! God knows when he was betrayed by the other party!
The scammer who had always been arrogant and boasted about his ability and academic qualifications. His various certificates were enough to make a deck of playing cards, and his annual salary requirement must not be less than 500,000. After the sudden whim of the company boss made the news, his road to applying for the job came to an end.
He was rejected by various companies one after another, and no one even applied for a job as a handyman in the supermarket to clean toilets - he had no goods and no character, and was afraid that he would steal things.
In the end, this person had no choice but to go to the construction site to resist cement, just because they didn't look at resumes when recruiting workers, and because of a drunken complaint and his identity was exposed, he was kicked out of the construction site by the contractor - without him, no one wants to be stabbed in the back by his teammates.
Since the first company that used interviewees' bad performance in Dota-X to evaluate their character became a great success, this interview model has been rapidly popularized, severely deterring a group of cheaters, and making a huge contribution to purifying the online environment.
Bonus points for the college entrance examination and the final decision in the interview. It seems that Dota-X is already great, but in fact the charm of Dota-X is far from limited to the human world. Even many high-ranking gods have been captured by its charm and began to build a life-and-death game with Dota.
